description: Discover verified, escrow-protected Paylo storefronts. Filter by Nigerian state, product category, area (LGA/city) and/or free text — e.g. 'phone sellers in Lagos' or 'beauty stores in Abuja'. Only quality-gated sellers are returned (verified, with a logo, a cover image and at least one live listing), ordered by number of live listings. Each result carries trust signals (verified, escrowProtected), location (state, area) and its storefront URL.

area.description: LGA/city area within a state, e.g. 'abuja-municipal'.

query.description: Free text over name, description, category and area.

state.description: Nigerian state slug or name, e.g. 'lagos', 'ogun', 'abuja'/'FCT'.

name: search_storefronts
